# pbs_metrics_servers (Data Source)

Lists all metrics server configurations from Proxmox Backup Server.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `servers` (Attributes List) List of metrics servers. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--servers))

<a id="nestedatt--servers"></a>
### Nested Schema for `servers`

Read-Only:

- `bucket` (String) InfluxDB bucket name.
- `comment` (String) A comment describing this metrics server configuration.
- `enable` (Boolean) Whether metrics export to this server is enabled.
- `max_body_size` (Number) Maximum body size for HTTP requests in bytes.
- `mtu` (Number) Maximum transmission unit for the metrics connection.
- `name` (String) The unique name identifier for the metrics server.
- `organization` (String) InfluxDB organization name.
- `port` (Number) The server port extracted from URL or Host field.
- `server` (String) The server address extracted from URL or Host field.
- `type` (String) The type of metrics server (e.g., `influxdb-udp`, `influxdb-http`).
- `url` (String) Full URL for InfluxDB HTTP.
- `verify_tls` (Boolean) Whether to verify TLS certificate for HTTPS connections.
